methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-backed community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals grassroots capacity-building in a historically underserved region, suggesting distributed skill development beyond traditional tech hubs if sustained through peer networks.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding deep training infrastructure suggests shallow adoption driven by employer demands rather than systematic capability development, risking displacement over empowerment.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA concentrates advanced defense AI capabilities in the metro corridor, deepening technical expertise where federal contracting infrastructure already dominates.

signals.title: Hampton Roads taking steps to prepare for data centers - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: Hampton Roads preparing infrastructure for data centers signals platform-dependent adoption where the region becomes service provider for compute resources rather than developer of indigenous AI capability or applications.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College partnership with ed2go for on-demand workforce training creates accessible learning pathways in a non-metro region, potentially enabling distributed skill acquisition if learners translate platform access into deep practice.
